product.title: 2 Hour Private Tour - Hollywood and Beverly Hills Celebrity Homes

travelerPickup.additionalInfo: For this particular tour, Glitterati Tours has listed a handful of fantastic starting points. We can also pick up anywhere within the city limits of West Hollywood and Beverly Hills. Please keep in mind that Los Angeles is a MASSIVE spread out city, so we have to limit tours to the starting locations provided. Therefore, there are many places outside of the area that we cannot start or end tours, which includes locations such as Downtown Los Angeles, LAX, Santa Monica, San Pedro, Long Beach and Anaheim.

product.description:
Your private 2-hour tour will showcase the residences of prominent movie stars and other affluent individuals. You will explore the communities of the Hollywood Hills, as well as the prestigious Platinum Triangle area, which includes Beverly Hills, Holmby Hills, and Bel Air. Travel comfortably in a discreet luxury black SUV, with the option to tailor the tour according to your specific interests. Your highly-rated professional host is well-informed about the latest developments among notable personalities, ensuring that this tour offers the most accurate insights into celebrity real estate within our city.

*In the tour details listed above, there are few options that best describe timeframes for stops and drive-by introductions. Plus, there are a handful of locations not listed in available "Attractions." Some attractions may not be accessible on certain days of the year. This tour is a solid 2 hours, and we've laid out a guesstimate on stops and travel time.

A reminder that this is not a group tour. Every tour we do is private, so it's just you and your immediate party. Tours are conducted in luxury discreet black SUV's, and guests are welcome to customize their excursion by their timeframe and interests. Our tours come highly recommended by the 5-Star Beverly Hills and Los Angeles area hotel concierge desks, as well as countless domestic and international travel agents and travel sites.
We use the tier pricing format here on TripAdvisor Experiences. When entering the number of guests for your private tour, the amount will be the equivalent of our regular posted rates.
Only service animals as defined by the ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) and California state law allowed. Emotional support dogs or other animals prohibited.
